input.summary: Add deliverable conformance warranty, no-malicious-code warranty and a repair/replace/refund remedy to § 5.1, and carve the express warranties out of the § 5.4(c) "AS IS" disclaimer.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 5.1 gives us a services standard but no warranty that Materials conform to their documentation, no malicious code warranty and no remedy, and § 5.4(c) puts all Materials "AS IS", which swallows the express warranty. We added a 90-day conformance and malicious code warranty with re-performance, repair, replacement or refund, and carved the § 5.1 warranties out of the disclaimer; we can discuss a shorter conformance period if needed.

ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Deliverable and item of Materials will conform in all material respects to its documentation and to the applicable Service Option Attachment; and

d. the Services, Materials and e-business Hosting Environment will not knowingly contain any virus, worm, time bomb or other malicious code introduced by IBM. Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 5.1 is, at IBM's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Materials, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services or Materials.

ops.oldText: c. IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
ops.newText: c. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
